blocks.value: Promoters are the founders or controlling owners of a company. Promoter Holding tells us how much of the company they continue to own.
Imagine This: A family builds a successful hotel. Years later, they still own 70% of it. This shows they continue to have confidence in the business they created.
Many investors prefer companies where promoters continue to hold a meaningful stake because it aligns their interests with other shareholders.
⚠️ High promoter holding alone is not enough. Always consider the company's financial performance and corporate governance.
If promoters increase their ownership over time, some investors see it as a positive sign. If they reduce it significantly, investors may try to understand the reason.
Look for trends in promoter holding over several quarters instead of focusing on one number.

blocks.question: Who are promoters?
choices: Founders or controlling owners of a company.
